steps.content: The deranged rioters charge at you and more gangs are dragged into the mayhem.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: They call it a classified operation? See? They already know.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Catch that Sinner! Find out who betrayed us!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No, protect the Chief. The enemy is targeting.

Before the sentence was finished, a black beam jabs at you. You instinctively block it with your hand, but it is impossible to be blocked. Everything suddenly slows down. This moment, you lock eyes with the killer.
Those hollow eyes show no emotions. No bloodthirsty madness, nor the slightest confusion or hesitation—only your death is reflected in them.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!
Bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang—!

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: Uhh!
The gray-haired girl tumbles down to the ground. The bullets miss the vital parts but leave several bloody holes on her lean body. Her face grows paler as she stumbles toward the dark alley.
Don't go after her!

steps.speaker: Red-haired Man
steps.content: The gangs ahead have been infected by her Mania. It's too dangerous. Follow me.
You turn into the dark alleys to escape the rioter fights. The whole area descends into chaos and madness.

The thugs are growing stronger, while their minds break down one after another. Sounds of gunfire, lights reflecting from swinging blades, they fly everywhere while the thugs are losing their minds to the desire of killing and destruction.

steps.speaker: Red-haired Man
steps.content: You big cheese from the east must have never seen this side of the DisCity.

steps.speaker: Red-haired Man
steps.content: The world's most prosperous and affluent megalopolis has been given the notorious name of "<color=#fb9259>The City of Sins</color>". The crime rate is increasing, yet the authorities see no solution.

steps.speaker: Red-haired Man
steps.content: It's all because of this <color=#fb9259>Mania plague</color>, which pollutes the minds, amplifies human evil, empowers the wicked, and leads to collective madness.

steps.speaker: Red-haired Man
steps.content: Those Sinner monsters are the source of the Mania.
Clang—!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Watch your mouth, scoundrel. Who did you call a monster?
Hella's pipe dents the rusted pipes in the alley. The man shoots Hella a cold glance while remaining indifferent.

steps.speaker: Red-haired Man
steps.content: It is precisely this evil power that comes from the Mania and spreads Mania. They have turned Syndicate into a mess.

steps.speaker: Red-haired Man
steps.content: Sorry, I haven't introduced myself yet.

steps.speaker: Red-haired Man
steps.content: I'm <color=#fb9259>Ted</color>, an informant and assistant for the local security precinct in Syndicate, and the one who knows about this operation. The Bureau sent me here to meet you.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: You're cautious, which is a good thing in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Take this. It's from the Public Security Bureau. You've lost contact with your people for a while now, haven't you?
He takes out a headset and hands it to you. The headset starts ringing.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, it's me.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Nightingale?!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I'm a gangster in Syndicate and a victim of Mania. I want to wipe out those monsters and restore order in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: That is why I need you. I know MBCC has the power to wipe them out.
